title: The Eyeshadow Palette Holiday Edit
descriptionHtml:
✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Cruelty-Free
What it is: A limited-edition, six-shade powder eyeshadow palette with weightless, blendable neutrals and a festive shimmer for every holiday look.

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Vegetable-Based Ester: Delivers an effortless, slip-on glide and cushiony, comfortable feel.
- Micronized Mica Pigments: Ensure a smooth, even application and seamless adhesion.
- Rose Flower Extract (matte shades): Firms and smooths the look of fine lines.

Ingredient Callouts: These products are cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: Your go-to holiday palette. Five everyday, neutral matte shades that build beautifully with a whisper-soft finish, and shimmering Buck’s Fizz to dial up the festivity. Weightless and blendable, wear one sw
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Sweep a lighter shade across the lid.
-Swirl brush over formula for maximum pigment pickup.
-Layer deeper shades to accentuate shape and build intensity.
-Add shimmer wherever you want a pop, like to the center of the lids and inner corners.
Ingredients+
-Vegetable-Based Ester: Delivers an effortless, slip-on glide and cushiony, comfortable feel.
-Micronized Mica Pigments: Ensure smooth, even application and seamless adhesion.
-Rose Flower Extract (matte shades): Visibly firms and smooths the look of fine lines

Shades Caviar, Mocha, Beige, Cashmere, Tusk:
Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Lauroyl Lysine, Aluminum Starch Octenylsuccinate, Zinc Stearate, Diisostearyl Malate, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, P-Anisic Acid, Glyceryl Caprylate, Rosa Hybrid Flower Extract, May Contain/Peut Contenir (+/-): Mica, Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Iron Oxides (CI 77491), Iron Oxides (CI 77492), Iron Oxides (CI 77499), Manganese Violet (CI 77742).

Shade Buck’s Fizz:
Glass Beads, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Diisostearyl Malate, Calcium Sodium Borosilicate, Calcium Aluminum Borosilicate, Mica, Zinc Stearate, Zea Mays (Corn) Starch, Glyceryl Caprylate, P-Anisic Acid, Tin Oxide, Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Iron Oxides (CI 77491), Yellow 5 Lake (CI 19140).

The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
